data.claim: The company's philosophy is that food has the power to enhance quality of life at every stage.
data.proof_in_source: The company's public communications frame this as a belief in food's power to enhance quality of life at every stage, from infancy through old age, and across everyday moments from breakfast to family meals.

data.claim: The brand is a science-led enabler of wellbeing.
